request.text:
A: How dreadful. Someone will have to decide what to do with them. Not me, I hope.
<long pause>
A: Clever. You've been listening to me. Very well, my stores for the little ones. Lent at interest, naturally.
<long pause>
A: Well. That does rather change the interest.
<long pause>
B: Found them under the bridge, behind the pilings. Too weak to run with the rest. Neither of them's bigger than Pip, Halden.
<long pause>
B: She bit me twice on the way here. I'd call that healthy.
<long pause>
B: I'll take the little ones home tonight. Pip can teach them to steal bread properly.
